mapper.select: SELECT dcr04.dcr04_emp_auth_id AS emp_auth_id, dcr04.dcr04_person_id AS person_id, dcr04.dcr04_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, dcr04.dcr04_org_nm AS org_name, dcr04.dcr04_person_nm AS person_name, dcr04.dcr04_pos_nm AS pos_name, dcr04.dcr04_kind_nm AS kind_name, dcr04.dcr04_note AS note, dcr04.dcr04_retrieve_yn AS retrieve_yn FROM ( SELECT a.*, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS dcr04_org_nm, b.emp01_kor_nm AS dcr04_person_nm, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS dcr04_pos_nm, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'kind_nm') AS dcr04_kind_nm FROM dcr04_emp_auth a INNER JOIN emp01_person b ON b.emp01_person_id = a.dcr04_person_id WHERE a.dcr04_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND b.emp01_company_id = #{companyId} ) dcr04 WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CONCAT(dcr04_org_nm, dcr04_person_nm, dcr04_pos_nm, dcr04_kind_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY dcr04_org_nm, dcr04_person_nm DESC

SELECT dcr04_person_id AS person_id, MAX(dcr04_org_nm) AS org_name, MAX(dcr04_person_nm) AS person_name, MAX(dcr04_pos_nm) AS pos_name, MAX(dcr04_kind_nm) AS kind_name FROM ( SELECT a.*, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS dcr04_org_nm, b.emp01_kor_nm AS dcr04_person_nm, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS dcr04_pos_nm, f_get_empTrans(b.emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'kind_nm') AS dcr04_kind_nm FROM dcr04_emp_auth a INNER JOIN emp01_person b ON b.emp01_person_id = a.dcr04_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} ) dcr04 WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(dcr04_org_nm, dcr04_person_nm, dcr04_pos_nm, dcr04_kind_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) GROUP BY dcr04_person_id ORDER BY MAX(dcr04_org_nm), MAX(dcr04_person_nm) DESC

SELECT dcr04.dcr04_emp_auth_id AS emp_auth_id, dcr04.dcr04_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, dcr04.dcr04_class_tree_full_nm AS class_tree_full_name FROM ( SELECT a.*, f_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.dcr04_class_tree_id) AS dcr04_class_tree_full_nm FROM dcr04_emp_auth a INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree b ON b.dcr01_class_tree_id = a.dcr04_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr04_person_id = #{personId} AND b.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} ) dcr04 WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(dcr04_class_tree_full_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY dcr04_class_tree_full_nm DESC
